requirements: R1: Clear or retry 5 failed tasks to unblock Flow Core from BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state and resume active work

slices.title: Patch Flow Core to clear failed frontier state
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state fix for this epic, I want to patch the existing Flow Core, so that the 5 failed tasks are resolved and system resumes processing.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Flow Core is in BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state with failed tasks
When the unblock patch logic is executed
Then the failed tasks are retried or cleared
And the flow core resumes active work processing successfully
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Flow Core blocked time from indefinite to 0 minutes
